segments.name: Bank
segments.description: Savings bank that takes deposits and makes residential, commercial and construction loans in its Texas market area.
segments.evidence: The Company's single reportable segment, the Bank, generates revenues primarily from interest income from financial instruments and non-interest income and service charges on deposit accounts.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans, and deposit customers pay fees for account, transaction and overdraft services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company earns fees from its deposit customers for transaction-based, account-maintenance, and overdraft services.
